_comment: Vocabulary for parsing Vertex AI SKU descriptions (Cloud Billing catalog / billing export sku.description). The text is lowercased, 'phrase_rewrites' run on the whole string, then it is split into tokens on anything but letters, digits and dots. Leading 'skip_leading_tokens' are dropped; the model name is the tokens up to the first stop token (every token used by a direction/deployment/modality rule is also a stop token). Rules are tried in order; the first whose 'all' tokens are all present wins. Model names go through gcp_skus.canonical_model, so SKU models and Cloud Monitoring model_user_id values meet on one name.
_unverified: Assumption (spike-gcp): only the six demo SKUs ('Gemini 2.5 Flash Text Input - Predictions' etc.) are taken as given. Every other spelling here (Flash-Lite, image/audio/video input, cached input / context cache storage, long-context tiers ('Long', '> 200K'), thinking output, batch, priority/flex tiers, embeddings, Imagen/Veo per image or second, Claude/Llama/Mistral partner models) is inferred from Google's public Vertex AI pricing page, not from the live catalog. `act spike-gcp` lists the real descriptions and which ones still fail; anything that fails lands in the unmapped-meter admin queue.
_direction_comment: Directions the estimator uses are exactly 'input' and 'output' (text tokens, standard tier). Long-context tiers become input_long/output_long/cached_input_long and thinking output becomes output_thinking, so a SKU billed above a context threshold or a separate thinking rate never becomes the base rate in estimates. pricing/gcp_catalog prefixes image/audio/video modality onto the direction (image_input), as pricing/retail does for Azure, because token metrics count all modalities together and the text rate is the honest default.
_known_models_comment: Model names that start with or contain a token which would otherwise end the name ('text', 'image', ...). Matched at the start of the token list, longest first.
_phrase_rewrites_comment: Regex substitutions on the lowercased description before tokenising. Assumption (spike-gcp): long-context tiers are spelled 'Long ...', '> 128K'/'> 200K' or 'Long Context'; '<= 200K' marks the standard tier.
_model_rewrites_comment: Regex substitutions on the hyphenated model name, applied in order by canonical_model. They join SKU spellings ('Imagen 3 Fast', 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2', 'Mistral Large (24.11)') with model ids ('imagen-3.0-fast-generate-001', 'claude-3-5-sonnet-v2@20241022', 'mistral-large-2411'). Assumption (spike-gcp).
_numeric_comment: Families whose trailing three-digit number is part of the model's identity (text-embedding-004), not a version (gemini-2.0-flash-001, gemini-embedding-001).
_modality_comment: 'text' is a modality but also starts 'text-embedding'; known_models takes those names whole first.
_family_defaults_comment: When a SKU names no direction/modality: embeddings bill input text; Imagen bills generated images and Veo generated seconds of video ('tokens': false, so the catalog never stores tokens_per_unit for them). Assumption (spike-gcp).
_stop_comment: Tokens that end the model name besides rule tokens.
